anti_overlap: Focuses on infrastructure and deployment, not design or content
decision_lens: Operational simplicity — can a solo dev manage both sites without DevOps overhead?
focus: Deployment architecture for two Cloudflare Pages projects sharing a domain — DNS, routing, HTTPS, and CI/CD
name: fd-cloudflare-deployment-architecture
persona: Platform engineer who manages multi-site Cloudflare deployments for content-heavy organizations
review_areas: Two Pages projects on the same Cloudflare account — apex domain vs subdomain routing
HTTPS certificate provisioning for both elfrevel.com and wiki.elfrevel.com
GitHub Actions deployment for two independent sites from one repo
Cache invalidation — do wiki deploys bust landing page cache or vice versa?
og:image and social preview metadata for both sites
Fallback behavior — what happens if one site is down?

severity_examples.condition: DNS misconfiguration causes the landing page to be unreachable
severity_examples.scenario: Apex domain (elfrevel.com) cannot use CNAME — needs A record or Cloudflare proxy

severity_examples.condition: Missing Open Graph metadata on both sites
severity_examples.scenario: No og:image tags means social shares look like generic links

success_hints: Both sites deploy independently, HTTPS works on both domains, GitHub Actions are separate workflows, cache is isolated between sites
task_context: The wiki is already deployed at wiki.elfrevel.com — the landing page adds a second deployment target on the same domain
